topic: Type of grease and lubricants and their uses
syllabus_extract: Type of grease and lubricants and their uses
specific_objectives: 24.1.3.1 Trainee will be able to identify various types of greases, fluids and compounds.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Identification of grease types using sample kits; Safety: Wear gloves and eye protection; Supervision: Instructor monitors sample handling
intro_questions: What is the primary function of a lubricant in an aircraft engine?
Name one common type of grease used in aviation maintenance.
Why is it critical to select the correct lubricant for specific aircraft parts?

development.content:
Classification of Aviation Greases
Lithium Complex Grease Properties
Synthetic Grease Applications
Selection Criteria for Greases

Hydraulic Fluid Types and Viscosity
Anti-Corrosion Compound Usage
Deicing and Anti-Freezing Compounds

Coolant Liquids and Water Mixtures
Lubricant Storage and Handling
Contamination Prevention Measures

summary_questions: Explain the difference between lithium complex and synthetic greases based on operating temperature.
Describe the specific use case for anti-corrosion compounds on aircraft metal surfaces.
How does improper selection of hydraulic fluid affect aircraft system performance?
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief report comparing the properties of standard hydraulic fluids with those used in water injection mixtures, referencing the next lesson plan (LP 05).

pft_rows.syllabus: Various types of hydraulic fluids, anti-corrosion compounds, deicing and anti-freezing compounds, coolant liquids, water injection mixtures, cooling oils, transformer oils, flushing oil, corrosion inhibitors etc.
